correctness.rationale: Cyclic full-return maps g_i are related by semiconjugacies f_i with inverses on their period-n fixed-point sets, so all have a_n fixed points. The permutation of s coordinates effected by F^m decomposes into d=gcd(m,s) cycles, each imposing g_i^(m/d)(x)=x, proving #Fix(F^m)=a_(m/d)^d without injectivity of individual f_i. With exact trace a_n=tr A^n, cyclic tensor operator B has trace tr(B^m)=a_(m/d)^d and zeta det(I−zB)^(-1). For s=2, tr(Λ²A)^n=(a_n²−a_(2n))/2 yields the exterior-square factor; a rational one-variable zeta gives a finite signed eigenvalue product and hence rational coupled zeta. Independent exhaustive finite-map checks covered 2352 families for s in {2,3,4}, not arbitrary continuous maps.
residual_risks: Trace matrix must reproduce physical fixed-point counts for every n, not a symbolic adjacency model with endpoint overcount.
The finite fixed-point assumption is essential; no result for infinite fixed-point sets.
